limits: Factors are actual Eq11.3-1 evaluations of stated fixed hypotheses, not actual selected Cg. Minimum over this finite hypothesis list is not a proven continuous interval bound or an oblique-area rule.

Bell blocks and pair-distance pitches are intentionally over-inclusive counterfactual uniform-row hypotheses. Actual straight/uniform/stagger row assignment, force alignment, and common-mode fitting load-path ownership remain unqualified.

Parallel gross and perpendicular equivalent-area hypotheses are separate cardinal branches. The 3D/4D single-row width choices reference Table12.5.1B minimum/unreduced parallel spacing; no actual Cdelta or oblique interpolation is adopted.
The multi-row equivalent-area hypothesis uses the measured overall grainwise center span. Its boundary and applicability are conditional; a zero span is excluded rather than assigned zero EA.
One full physical gross flat flange is counted for each wood/steel interface, with no hole deduction, extra angle leg, or FE-calibrated effective fitting stiffness.

Ordinary bearing-induced internal dowel moments are included in TR12 yield mechanisms; a nonzero port moment alone is not treated as an independent applied couple. Genuine imposed couples, N/T, washer/capture, heel coupling, brittle wood, geometry and complete interactions remain separate.
Raw-port absolute-force sums are preserved in earlier evidence but are not the net lateral demand here. The 21 earlier bounds are not deleted or automatically cleared.
Actual property conformity, fitting/stock geometry, plywood bond and complete 24-axis mixed-media capacity remain unqualified.
